messages:
Lina Torres: Quick flag ":point_up:" — our new CI/CD integration that auto-creates scorecards from recorded interviews is creating duplicates when interviewers also click 'Create scorecard' manually. Analytics shows some candidates with two scorecards, which doubles their weight in the hiring dashboard. Can we triage?

CI/CD Bot: Integration run summary 2026-11-02T09:15:02Z: created=124, duplicates_detected=5, failures=0. Log: https://ci.redwood/integrations/scorecards/20261102

Greg Wu: Thanks Lina. I can run a de-dupe query to identify dupes by interview_id + submitted_at window. Quick SQL to find suspects:
```sql
SELECT interview_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, array_agg(id) as ids
FROM scorecards
WHERE created_via IN ('ci-integration','manual') AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY interview_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
We can auto-merge if duplicates are identical or flag for manual review.

Ben Y: Agree — auto-merge safe when rating & template_id match and notes identical. If notes differ we should keep both and surface to recruiter to reconcile. Also recommend we add a DB unique partial index on (interview_id, coalesce(hash(notes),'') , rating) to catch exact dupes at write time.

Emily (People Ops): Operational asks: 1) please add a short audit event when auto-merge happens (so we can track), 2) notify recruiters for any non-exact dupes and provide a one-click reconcile UI. Also can we pause the CI runnable that posts scorecards until dedupe is in place? Some interviewers are on panels this week.

Greg Wu: I'll pause the integration for 1 hour and kick off a backfill + dedupe job. De-dup pseudo: compare rating, template_id, normalized notes; if exact-match -> mark duplicate=true and keep earliest. If conflicts -> create ticket HIRE-3125 assigned to recruiting for manual reconcile.

CI/CD Bot: Integration paused by Greg Wu.

Recruiting Bot: Ticket created: HIRE-3125 (scorecard-duplicate-reconcile) assigned to Emily (People Ops).

Lina Torres: Thanks. Small process change request: remind interviewers not to manually create the scorecard if they use the record+auto flow. Short note in the invitation template should help. Can People Ops add a one-line reminder and a 30-second how-to GIF?

Emily (People Ops): Will do. I'll update the interview invite text to include: "If you recorded the interview with the Redwood recorder, do not also click 'Create scorecard' — the system will create it automatically. If unsure, ask your recruiter." I'll also add a 30s GIF and a 2-question micro-quiz in the hiring-toolkit.

Ben Y: For longer-term fix I'll add idempotency to the integration: post with a dedupe key (interview_id + submitter_id + day) and let the API check and return 409 if already processed. That avoids race conditions. ETA: 3 days.

Greg Wu: Backfill job ran: scanned 14k scorecards, found 12 duplicates in the last week, auto-merged 9, flagged 3 -> HIRE-3125. Link to backfill report: https://internal.jobs/backfill_20261102

Recruiting Bot: HIRE-3125 updated: 3 flagged scorecards added to recruiter reconcile queue.

Emily (People Ops): I'll draft the invite copy and post the GIF. Also scheduling two 20-min micro-sessions next week for frequent interviewers: Tue 10:00 UTC & Thu 18:00 UTC. Will include the micro-quiz; passing quiz will auto-tag interviewers as "calibrated" in the roster.

Lina Torres: Nice. One more ask: can analytics exclude auto-merged duplicates from historical dashboards immediately? We don't want skew during the fix window.

Greg Wu: Done — analytics ETL now filters out scorecards with duplicate_of not null. I'll push a cleaned metrics snapshot to the hiring dashboard; expect corrected numbers in ~30m.

Emily (People Ops): Closing loop: integration paused then resumed after backfill + idempotency plan queued, invites updated, training scheduled, ticket HIRE-3125 created. I'll report back with micro-quiz RSVP numbers. :white_check_mark:
